mapper.sql: id, match_number, ebank_number, ebank_serial_number, match_amount, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag
mapper.select: select em.ebank_number ,em.ebank_serial_number, sum(em.match_amount) bank_amount from eg_fund_ebank_transaction_data et inner join eg_fund_business_system_ebank_mapping em on et.ebank_number = ANY ( STRING_TO_ARRAY(em.ebank_number, ',')) and em.del_flag ='0' where et.del_flag ='0' and et.currency_type='RMB' and et.collection_type in ('VC_SHOUKLX01','VC_SHOUKLX06','VC_SHOUKLX07','VC_SHOUKLX03') and not exists ( select 1 from eg_non_confirm_collection_sum cs where cs.del_flag='0' and et.ebank_number=cs.ebank_number) group by em.ebank_number ,em.ebank_serial_number union all select et.ebank_number ,et.ebank_number ebank_serial_number, sum(et.bank_amount) bank_amount from eg_fund_ebank_transaction_data et left join eg_fund_business_system_ebank_mapping ebn on et.ebank_number = ANY(STRING_TO_ARRAY(ebn.ebank_number, ',')) and ebn.del_flag ='0' where et.del_flag ='0' and et.currency_type='RMB' and et.collection_type in ('VC_SHOUKLX01','VC_SHOUKLX06','VC_SHOUKLX07','VC_SHOUKLX03') and not exists ( select 1 from eg_non_confirm_collection_sum cs where cs.del_flag='0' and et.ebank_number=cs.ebank_number) and ebn.id is null group by et.ebank_number union all select em.ebank_number ,em.ebank_serial_number, sum(em.match_amount) bank_amount from eg_fund_business_system_ebank_mapping em left join eg_fund_ebank_transaction_data et on et.ebank_number = ANY ( STRING_TO_ARRAY(em.ebank_number, ',')) and et.del_flag ='0' and et.currency_type='RMB' and et.collection_type in ('VC_SHOUKLX01','VC_SHOUKLX06','VC_SHOUKLX07','VC_SHOUKLX03') where em.del_flag ='0' and not exists ( select 1 from eg_non_confirm_collection_sum cs where cs.del_flag='0' and em.ebank_number=cs.ebank_number) and et.id is null group by em.ebank_number ,em.ebank_serial_number

WITH s_m AS (select t.match_number, sum(t.collect_amount) as collect_amount from (SELECT pc.match_number, ob.collect_amount FROM eg_fund_business_system_ebank_pc_amount pc JOIN eg_hy_full_online_bank_batch_no_mapping ob ON pc.ebank_serial_number = ob.online_bank_no order by pc.match_number) t GROUP BY t.match_number) SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT e.business_date AS business_date, a.create_time, a.match_number AS match_number, a.ebank_number AS ebank_number, a.ebank_serial_number AS ebank_serial_number, a.match_amount AS match_amount, s_m.collect_amount AS collect_amount, (a.match_amount - s_m.collect_amount) AS diff_amount, e.is_send_kingdee AS send_kingdee FROM eg_fund_business_system_ebank_mapping a LEFT JOIN s_m ON a.match_number = s_m.match_number LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, interface_id, period_code, is_send_kingdee, business_date FROM eg_voucher WHERE period_code = #{periodCode} AND del_flag = '0' AND id IN (SELECT voucher_id FROM eg_voucher_entry WHERE period_code = #{periodCode} AND account_code LIKE '1002%' AND del_flag = '0')) e ON e.interface_id = a.id WHERE e.id IS NOT NULL) t_
and t_.diff_amount = 0
and t_.diff_amount > 0

WITH s_m AS (select t.match_number, sum(t.collect_amount) as collect_amount from (SELECT pc.match_number, ob.collect_amount FROM eg_fund_business_system_ebank_pc_amount pc JOIN eg_hy_full_online_bank_batch_no_mapping ob ON pc.ebank_serial_number = ob.online_bank_no order by pc.match_number) t GROUP BY t.match_number) SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT e.business_date AS business_date, a.create_time, a.match_number AS match_number, a.ebank_number AS ebank_number, a.ebank_serial_number AS ebank_serial_number, a.match_amount AS match_amount, s_m.collect_amount AS collect_amount, (a.match_amount - s_m.collect_amount) AS diff_amount, e.is_send_kingdee AS send_kingdee FROM eg_fund_business_system_ebank_mapping a LEFT JOIN s_m ON a.match_number = s_m.match_number LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, interface_id, period_code, is_send_kingdee, business_date FROM eg_voucher WHERE period_code = #{periodCode} AND del_flag = '0' AND id IN (SELECT voucher_id FROM eg_voucher_entry WHERE period_code = #{periodCode} AND account_code LIKE '1002%' AND del_flag = '0')) e ON e.interface_id = a.id WHERE e.id IS NOT NULL) t_
and t_.match_number = #{matchNumber}

select efbsepa.ebank_serial_number as ebank_serial_number, ehfobbnm.deduct_batch_no as deduct_batch_no, efbsepa.business_match_amount as business_match_amount, COALESCE(s_m.collect_amount, 0) as collect_amount, efbsepa.business_match_amount - COALESCE(s_m.collect_amount, 0) diff_amount from eg_fund_business_system_ebank_pc_amount efbsepa left join eg_hy_full_online_bank_batch_no_mapping ehfobbnm on efbsepa.ebank_serial_number = ehfobbnm.online_bank_no left join (select ebank_serial_number, sum(ob.collect_amount) AS collect_amount from eg_fund_business_system_ebank_pc_amount pc left join eg_hy_full_online_bank_batch_no_mapping ob on pc.ebank_serial_number = ob.online_bank_no where pc.match_number = #{matchNumber} group by ebank_serial_number) s_m on s_m.ebank_serial_number = efbsepa.ebank_serial_number where efbsepa.match_number = #{matchNumber} order by ehfobbnm.collect_amount desc, efbsepa.ebank_serial_number, deduct_batch_no

SELECT m.create_time, m.online_bank_no, m.deduct_batch_no, m.collect_amount FROM eg_hy_full_online_bank_batch_no_mapping m LEFT JOIN eg_fund_business_system_ebank_pc_amount e ON m.online_bank_no = e.ebank_serial_number WHERE e.ebank_serial_number IS NULL
